payload.body: hv's ruling on the WP06 floor's reach, given to cc on 22 Oct: rhadamanth yes, the floor lands there and binds every session on it. gyges no for now: hv is away and cannot reach it without first setting up Tailscale, so gyges is not upgraded until hv says. No code change: the scope rule stays 'every sleeve with an enabled sysadm agent'; gyges gets the floor at its next molt upgrade. Rollout order: kovacs and rhadamanth.
